gitCommit.subject: Promoters, their QR cards, registration sources and the promo code (0103, D221)
gitCommit.body:
Promoters, their QR cards, registration sources and the promo code (0103, D221)

- Console: a Promoters tab (create with display name, WhatsApp number and a private
  note; the number masked in the list), a promoter's page (explicit "Generate code
  and QR", copy, a printable/downloadable/shareable card in EN/FR/AR, activate and
  deactivate, regenerate confirmed twice, code history, attributed businesses) and a
  Registration sources report. Every decision after the password-and-code step-up.
- The card carries the brand, the display name, the code, the QR and one
  instruction — never the number, the note or an id. QR drawn in the browser
  (qrcode-generator 2.0.4, MIT, no dependencies), black on white via print tokens.
- /join on the portal and full builds: served by the app shell (noindex, no-store,
  no referrer), the token taken out of the address at once and asked about by POST;
  the full build continues to the application form with it in memory.
- The application form's optional promo code: six boxes left to right in every
  language, Arabic-Indic digits, paste, auto-advance and Backspace, checked at six
  digits, removable; an invitation and a code are never both kept.
- The public build's protected-areas alias now matches any depth: RouteScroll's
  `../protected-areas` had let the console's module graph into the public bundle.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01H7TfZHzwCoXvkvJ7ZuSzA9
